description:
FOUND s502 (Fable, 2026-09-30) while reviewing s500a's FLAGGED bench row (moo-objs +1.3..1.8 % min / +1.6 % median vs a 0.5 % control band, attributed by the agent's A/B to the new isweak store-clear on the general store path, `(unless (zerop (hash-table-count *p-weak-boxes*)) (remhash box *p-weak-boxes*))`, s500a commit 8e9a37b9).  Reading that site (the general-path store in the p-box setter, cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~3493 in the s500a tree): the line BEFORE the new clear is
    (remhash box *p-match-pos*)     ;; Perl: assigning to a scalar resets pos()
UNCONDITIONAL -- a hash-table delete on every general-path store, in every program, whether or not it ever set a pos().  The sibling site ~3431 (the other store arm) already guards the same reset:
    (unless (zerop (hash-table-count *p-match-pos*)) (remhash box *p-match-pos*))
so the two arms disagree (rule 11: one predicate), and the unguarded one is the hot one for object-heavy code (moo-objs stores a value per accessor call).  `*p-match-pos*` is an `eq` hash table (defvar ~3362, "Boxed string -> its /g match STATE"); `hash-table-count` is a slot read.
LEVER: guard ~3493 like ~3431.  Expected: a program that never uses pos()/`m//g` in scalar context pays one fixnum test instead of a remhash per store; s500a's flagged +1.3..1.8 % on moo-objs should be more than recovered (the isweak clear beside it stays -- it is already guarded).  MEASURE FIRST (round-39 filler, the bench-exec rows moo-objs ovlsub methret arrhash hashcopy strcat, interleaved, BENCH_K=5, control pair, load < 2); the guard changes NO semantics (a table with count 0 has nothing to remove) -- the guard row is the existing pos() tests (Pl/t + perl-tests/pos.t, re.t /g loops) unchanged.  Also check the s/// and tr/// store sites (33121, 33165, 33189 remhash on STRING keys) for the same unconditional shape -- those are per-match, not per-store, and may be left.


=== DONE (s507p, Opus, 2026-10-05; worktree agent-a55609aa75faa5780) ===
SHIPPED as the rule-11 repair: ONE predicate %p-clear-match-pos for box-set's two pos() resets (the general arm's REMHASH is now count-guarded like the fast arm's).  Bench (bench-all-1.log, K=5, all rows interleaved, load 0.7-1.8, control band -3.0..+5.1 %): no common row moved outside the band (m12 vs base: moo-objs -1.0, ovlsub +0.4, methret -0.9, arrhash +1.7, hashcopy -1.7, strcat +3.0) -- no measurable gain, no semantic change.  Guard Pl/t/perf-levers-08.t rows 1 + 8 (pos tests + perl-tests/pos.t = baseline).
subject: PERF filler (measure first): the general-path scalar store pays an UNCONDITIONAL `(remhash box *p-match-pos*)` on every store (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~3493) while its sibling site ~3431 already count-guards the same remhash -- guard it the same way (`(unless (zerop (hash-table-count *p-match-pos*)) ...)`), so a program that never uses pos()/m//g-in-scalar pays one count test instead of a hash delete per store
